7910.title: Git plugin snapshots unnecessarily require ancestor objects
7910.rootCauseOneLine: The shared git artifact materializer performs an unrestricted clone before detaching the selected commit and removing .git, so historical objects outside the selected snapshot are required.

prReviews.verdict: Closed, unmerged — directionally relevant; not executed
prReviews.topFinding: The proposed local broken-ref regression is Git-version-sensitive; the verified report uses an HTTP ancestor-blob fixture instead.

7910.proposedFix: Initialize an empty staging repository and fetch the selected commit at depth one without tags. Keep exact checkout verification, .git cleanup, cancellation propagation, and a clean full-clone fallback for unsupported direct fetches and abbreviated commit IDs.
7910.caveats: No production timing or download-size claims were measured. Abbreviated commit IDs are supported and need clone fallback. Same agent performed both clean runs.
